headline: St. Lucie County Firefighter-Paramedic Austin Hodge Dies in Line of Duty
teaser: Austin Hodge, a St. Lucie County firefighter-paramedic assigned to Station 9, died Saturday while on duty, the fire district announced.
body:
ST. LUCIE COUNTY — Firefighter-Paramedic Austin Hodge died Saturday, Oct. 24, while on duty, the St. Lucie County Fire District announced.

Hodge joined the district on July 17, 2017, and served the community for more than nine years. He was assigned to Station 9.

The district described his death as a profound loss to the department and the wider fire service community. It extended condolences to Hodge’s family, friends and fellow firefighters.

The district asked that the family’s privacy be respected as they grieve. Information about memorial arrangements and opportunities to honor Hodge’s service will be shared in coordination with his family once details are finalized.
